#                  fxc_10_0_26100:/T vs_5_1 /E VSRateMain"
# kept here because the tool overwrites manual-case-godbolt-verify.txt with
# whichever link is published last. Its own link is
#   https://godbolt.org/z/o4xKd6srd
#
# WHY THIS PANE IS *NOT* IN THE PUBLISHED LINK, and why its rejection is not
# evidence for this issue.
#
# The first pane is the control: same file, same compiler, declaration removed
# by /DNO_RATE, and it succeeds -- so the pane works and the file is something
# FXC can compile. The second pane puts the declaration back and FXC says:
#
#   error X4502: invalid vs_5_1 output semantic 'SV_ShadingRate'
#
# Read the profile in that message. FXC tops out at Shader Model 5.1 and
# SV_ShadingRate does not exist before Shader Model 6.4, so FXC is rejecting it
# at the ONE position the D3D12 Variable Rate Shading spec explicitly permits
# (vertex shader output). FXC is not disagreeing with DXC about hull and domain
# control-point signatures; it cannot express the feature at all. A pane whose
# rejection is equally certain for correct and incorrect code carries no
# information about which this is, so including it would only invite a reader
# to draw a conclusion the measurement does not support.
# Compiler Explorer panes for #3872, full output.
# Written by `triage.py godbolt` -- rerun it to re-derive.
# CE runs Linux Release builds: it corroborates the local
# Debug build and never overrules it.
